connect.condition: STATE.terminalUnlocked, only exact IP+port connect sets it
connect.latch: Judge per run; game state persists across clear
connect.route: optional for escape; never require for egg/fall
connect.reason: Interface gives command syntax, exact address and automatically decoded port; composition/copy is not formally scored as reasoning.

password.condition: #pwmsg reports correct after comparison with STATE.finalPassword
password.latch: Judge per run; delayed escape after 1200ms
password.route: escape outcome observed directly, no scored gate
password.reason: Automatic decryption explicitly yields THE ELEVATOR KEY IS KEYS; extracting and copying KEYS is diagnostic.

plaintext.condition: correct ciphertext and shift=3 adds final plaintext clue
plaintext.reason: The response provides shift and cipher; the supplied decrypt command performs the decoding.

coverage: all terminal branches, floor 1-25, help dialog/copy, all clue panels, positive/negative passwords, every ending, reset, direct password bypass

terminal_failures.fall: 三次非空错误坠落，终止失败，不计通关
